constraints.name: orders_manual_number_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (((order_number IS NULL) OR ((order_number = btrim(order_number)) AND ((char_length(order_number) >= 1) AND (char_length(order_number) <= 80)) AND (order_number !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text))))

indexes.name: orders_manual_number_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_manual_number_unique ON public.orders USING btree (bos_order_number_source(source), order_number) WHERE (order_number IS NOT NULL)

triggers.name: orders_check_manual_number
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER orders_check_manual_number BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF order_number, source ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION bos_check_manual_order_number()

triggers.name: zz_bos_confirm_order_amount
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER zz_bos_confirm_order_amount BEFORE UPDATE ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION bos_confirm_order_amount_on_change()
